DO NOT SCALE DRAWINGS FOR CONSTRUCTION PURPOSES. IN THE EVENT OF OMISSION OF NECESSARY
DIMENSION(S), NOTIFY THE ARCHITECT IN WRITING.
ALL DIMENSIONS ON 1/8", & 1/4" SCALE PLANS ARE TO THE FACE OF MASONRY, CONCRETE, OR THE FACE OF
GYPSUM BOARD, UNLESS NOTED OTHERWISE. ALL MASONRY DIMENSIONS ARE ACTUAL, UNLESS NOTED
OTHERWISE.
VERIFY ALL DIMENSIONS, CONDITIONS, EXISTING CONSTRUCTION, AND GRADES AT THE JOB SITE. NOTIFY
ARCHITECT IN WRITING OF ANY DISCREPANCIES OR CONFLICTS.
VERIFY SIZE, LOCATION, AND CHARACTERISTICS OF ALL WORK AND EQUIPMENT TO BE INSTALLED OR RELOCATED
WHETHER FURNISHED BY OWNER OR BY CONTRACTOR(S) BEFORE ANY CONSTRUCTION PERTAINING TO SAME HAS
BEGUN.
VERIFY AND COORDINATE THE SIZE AND LOCATION OF ALL THE OPENINGS FOR STRUCTURAL, MECHANICAL, &
ELECTRICAL WORK AND EQUIPMENT WITH ALL TRADES INVOLVED.
CONTRACTOR IS ADVISED THAT INVESTIGATION INDICATES THE EXISTING EXTERIOR SYSTEMS CONSIST OF THE
ELEMENTS DESCRIBED IN THE DRAWINGS. THESE DESCRIPTIONS ARE PROVIDED FOR INFORMATION ONLY.
CONTRACTOR SHALL VERIFY EXISTING CONDITIONS IN THE FIELD AND SHALL NOT RELY SOLELY ON THE
INFORMATION SHOWN.
DEMOLITION INFORMATION IS SHOWN THROUGHOUT THE DRAWINGS AND IS NOT LIMITED TO THE DEMOLITION
DRAWINGS.
VERIFY THAT REQUIRED OPERATION AND MAINTENANCE CLEARANCES ARE PROVIDED FOR ALL EQUIPMENT ITEMS.
INSTALL ALL ITEMS IN ACCORDANCE W/ THE MANUFACTURER'S WRITTEN INSTRUCTIONS, EXCEPT THAT THE
SPECIFICATIONS HEREIN, WHERE MORE STRINGENT, SHALL SUPERCEDE. NOTIFY THE ARCHITECT IN WRITING OF
ANY CONFLICTS.
REMOVE ROOFING DEBRIS DAILY. STORING DEBRIS OR MATERIALS ON THE ROOF IS NOT ALLOWED. KEEP
GROUNDS CLEAN AND FREE OF DEBRIS AT ALL TIMES.
ONLY DEMO AMOUNT/AREA THAT CAN BE REINSTALLED IN THE SAME DAY TO ENSURE THE EXISTING ROOF
REMAINS DRY.

PROJECT CONSISTS OF TARGETED REPAIR AND RESTORATION OF EXISTING ROOFING, BUILDING-ENVELOPE, AND
SITE-DRAINAGE SYSTEMS TO ADDRESS WATER INFILTRATION, DRAINAGE DEFICIENCIES, AND AGING OR
DETERIORATED MATERIALS. WORK GENERALLY INCLUDES, BUT IS NOT LIMITED TO, THE FOLLOWING:
RESTORE AND COAT EXISTING MODIFIED BITUMINOUS ROOFING SYSTEM WITH APPLICATION OF APPROVED
PRIMER AND SILICONE COATING SYSTEM. PROVIDE WALKWAYS AS INDICATED ON DRAWINGS, INCLUDING
ADDITIONAL COATING WITH APPROVED GRANULES/ AGGREGATE EMBEDDED IN WET COATING. PROVIDE 4"
YELLOW SAFETY STRIPE COATING AS NOTED ON PLANS.
CONTRACTOR SHALL PERFORM INFRARED MOISTURE SCAN OF EXISTING ROOF PRIOR TO COATING APPLICATION
TO VERIFY SUBSTRATE CONDITIONS AND COMPLY WITH MANUFACTURER WARRANTY REQUIREMENTS. PRIOR
MOISTURE SCAN (MAY 2026) IS PROVIDED FOR REFERENCE IN PROJECT MANUAL; NEW SCAN IS REQUIRED.
IDENTIFY, REMOVE, AND REPLACE ALL WET INSULATION AND DETERIORATED MATERIALS WITH NEW
COMPATIBLE ASSEMBLIES, INCLUDING MODIFIED BITUMEN PATCHING AS REQUIRED. VERIFY SUBSTRATE IS
CLEAN, DRY, AND SUITABLE TO RECEIVE COATING.
REMOVE AND REPLACE EXISTING STANDING-SEAM METAL ROOFING AND INTERNAL GUTTER AT THE LOW
CANOPY. PROVIDE NEW MECHANICALLY SEAMED STRUCTURAL METAL ROOF PANELS AND ASSOCIATED
STRUCTURAL BEARING/SHIM ASSEMBLIES OVER EXISTING STRUCTURAL STEEL FRAMING AS INDICATED ON THE
DRAWINGS TO ESTABLISH THE REQUIRED NEW ROOF SLOPE. COORDINATE PANEL SYSTEM, CLIPS,
ATTACHMENTS, SUPPORT CONDITIONS, AND THERMAL MOVEMENT REQUIREMENTS WITH THE METAL ROOF
MANUFACTURER AND STRUCTURAL DRAWINGS.
COPING SYSTEMS: REMOVE AND REPLACE EXISTING METAL COPING. MODIFY EXISTING NAILERS WITH TAPERED
FIRE-RETARDANT-TREATED WOOD BLOCKING AS REQUIRED TO PROVIDE POSITIVE SLOPE TOWARD THE ROOF.
PROVIDE NEW PREFINISHED METAL COPING SYSTEM WITH STANDING SEAM JOINTS, INCLUDING CONTINUOUS
CLEATS, JOINTS, SPLICE PLATES, AND ACCESSORIES REQUIRED FOR A COMPLETE WATERTIGHT INSTALLATION.
COLOR: SILVERSMITH OR APPROVED EQUAL.
THROUGH WALL FLASHING REPAIRS: REMOVE AND REPLACE DEFICIENT THROUGH-WALL FLASHING AT SELECT
LOCATIONS. PROVIDE NEW FLASHING, END DAMS, WEEPS, AND WATERTIGHT INTEGRATION WITH ADJACENT
WALL AND ROOFING SYSTEMS. THROUGH-WALL FLASHING NOTED TO REMAIN AT LOWER CANOPY ROOF, TO BE
PREPPED AND PAINTED SILVERSMITH TO MATCH ADJACENT WORK.
MASONRY AND SEALANT REPAIRS: REMOVE AND REPLACE SEALANT AT MASONRY CONTROL JOINTS, PRECAST
PANEL JOINTS, SIDEWALK EXPANSION JOINTS, PENETRATIONS, AND OTHER LOCATIONS INDICATED. PREPARE
AND REPAIR ADJACENT SUBSTRATES AS REQUIRED TO RECEIVE NEW SEALANT AND PROVIDE WATERTIGHT
JOINTS.
ALL EXTERIOR CONCRETE PRECAST PANELS AND MASONRY TO REMAIN. ALL CONCRETE PANELS AND MASONRY
TO BE PRESSURE WASHED ONCE ALL CONSTRUCTION HAS BEEN COMPLETED. ALL SIDEWALK BENEATH THE
CANOPY AND 15' OUTSIDE OF BUILDING FOOTPRINT TO BE POWERWASHED ONCE ALL CONSTRUCTION HAS BEEN
COMPLETED.
ROOF DRAINS: PROVIDE RETROFIT DRAIN INSERTS AT EXISTING ROOF DRAINS, INCLUDING PREPARATION OF
EXISTING DRAIN BODIES, INSTALLATION OF INSERTS, AND INTEGRATION WITH ROOFING SYSTEM TO PROVIDE
WATERTIGHT CONNECTIONS. ROOF DRAINS SHALL BE WATER TESTED AND INSPECTED.
MODIFY THE EXISTING CIVIL STORM-DRAINAGE SYSTEM AS INDICATED, INCLUDING NEW INLETS, UNDERGROUND
PIPING, CONNECTIONS TO THE EXISTING DRAINAGE SYSTEM, SWALES, CONCRETE BANDS, GRADING, AND
RESTORATION OF DISTURBED SITE IMPROVEMENTS.
PROVIDE A NEW POROUS GRASS-PAVING DRAINAGE SYSTEM ALONG THE BUILDING PERIMETER TO RECEIVE
ROOF DISCHARGE AND DIRECT SURFACE RUNOFF TOWARD NEW DRAINAGE INLETS. PROVIDE ASSOCIATED BASE
MATERIALS, SOIL INFILL, TURF (HYDROMULCHING), GRADING, AND TRANSITIONS TO ADJACENT PAVEMENT AND
LANDSCAPING.
CONDUCT GROUND-PENETRATING RADAR SCAN OR EXISTING PERIMETER SIDEWALKS WITH THE
APPROXIMATELY 10,000 SQUARE FOOT AREA BENEATH THE CANOPY. DRILL 1/4" HOLES NO CLOSER THAN 10 FEET
ON CENTER THROUGH AREAS IDENTIFIED AS VOIDS TO DETERMINE VOID DEPTH AT THAT LOCATION. PROVIDE
THE SCAN REPORT AND DEPTH LOG TO THE OWNER AND ARCHITECT FOR REVIEW. UPON OWNER'S DIRECTION,
INJECT CONTROLLED LOW-STRENGTH MATERIAL (CLSM) AT 100 PSI MAX STRENGTH TO FILL ALL IDENTIFIED
VOIDS. AVOID HYDROSTATIC LIFT OF THE SLAB UNLESS DIRECTED OTHERWISE BY OWNER. INCLUDE A BASE BID
ALLOWANCE FOR 100 CUBIC YARDS OF CLSM AND UNIT PRICING FOR ALL QUANTITIES ABOVE THE BASE BID.
PAYMENT WILL BE RECONCILED BASED ON THE FINAL INSTALLAED QUANTITY OF CLSM.
PROVIDE TEMPORARY PROTECTION REQUIRED TO MAINTAIN THE BUILDING INTERIOR IN A DUST-FREE AND
WATERTIGHT CONDITION AND TO PROTECT EXISTING ROOFING AND CONSTRUCTION TO REMAIN. LIMIT
DEMOLITION TO AREAS THAT CAN BE REINSTALLED OR MADE WATERTIGHT DURING THE SAME WORKDAY.
VERIFY EXISTING CONDITIONS BEFORE BEGINNING WORK. NOTIFY THE OWNER AND ARCHITECT OF
DETERIORATED, DAMAGED, OR UNSUITABLE CONCEALED MATERIALS BEFORE PROCEEDING WITH REPAIRS.
DEMOLITION DAMAGING EXISTING MATERIALS OR BUILDING COMPONENTS WHICH ARE TO REMAIN, OR
ADVERSELY AFFECTED BY OVERCUTS, CRACKS, OR OTHER DETRIMENTAL CONDITIONS AS A RESULT OF THE
WORK MUST BE REPAIRED OR REPLACED BY THE CONTRACTOR AT NO ADDITIONAL COSTS.
MAINTAIN CONTINUOUS WATERPROOFING, AIR-BARRIER CONTINUITY, WATERTIGHT TRANSITIONS, AND POSITIVE
DRAINAGE THROUGHOUT THE WORK.
